column1: # Every one-column matvec export of the Metal library (name starting kernel_mul_mv or kernel_norm_mul_mv), one row each.
# Read by check_mv_bodies.sh (every export in the .metal sources has exactly one row, every row its export) and by
# test_metal_mul_mat_cases tails (the tail cases are generated from the rows and their coverage is counted per row).
# To add an export: add its row with a case, or case none and the reason with the selector's line; check-mv-bodies names a missing one.
#   export: the function name in the library. file: its source under ggml/src/ggml-metal/. body: the function that reads the weight rows.
#   rows: what a row position from m on reads, in this tree: unbounded (the row past m) | bounded (clamped to m - 1) |
#         returns (returns before its address) | redirects (reads another valid row) | whole (launched for whole threadgroups only) | one-row (one row per threadgroup).
#   case: mat (MUL_MAT, one activation column) | id (MUL_MAT_ID, the last of 2 experts) | group (two MUL_MAT of one activation) | none.
#   weight, act: the weight and activation types of the case.
#   k: a number, page (the smallest multiple of 256 whose row is at least one host page) or page+2; <together>/<alone> when both placements run.
#   m: the partial row counts, a slash, the whole-group control (group: the two members' rows).
#   placements: together (all tensors in one buffer) | alone (the weight alone in its own buffer) | both.
#   cards: all, or the cards (a part of the Metal device name) on which the case must run this export; the case runs on every card.
#   reason: why the case is none or a placement is left out, with the selector's line.
